scripts.vendor: mkdir -p money_plan/static/js/vendor && cp node_modules/choices.js/public/assets/scripts/choices.min.js money_plan/static/js/vendor/choices.min.js && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js money_plan/static/js/vendor/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js money_plan/static/js/vendor/alpine.min.js && cp node_modules/sortablejs/Sortable.min.js money_plan/static/js/vendor/sortable.min.js
scripts.dev: pnpm run vendor && (esbuild money_plan/static/js/project.js --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=money_plan/static/js/project.min.js --watch=forever &) && tailwindcss -i money_plan/static/css/tailwind.css -o money_plan/static/css/project.min.css --watch=always
scripts.build: pnpm run vendor && esbuild money_plan/static/js/project.js --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=money_plan/static/js/project.min.js && tailwindcss -i money_plan/static/css/tailwind.css -o money_plan/static/css/project.min.css --minify
